description: Virix faction — growth on BISMUTH, spores, and swarm tactics.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Production on BISMUTH ◦ Virix do not rely on a separate factory line like Ertrians.◦ You may create units on any owned BISMUTH tile — income nodes double as incubators.Spread across the lattice and strike from unexpected angles.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Virix Spores ◦ Spores are flying capture units — terrain does not slow them. ◦ They cannot attack; they exist to slip past defenders.◦ To seize a structure, a Spore sacrifices itself — commit only when the capture is worth the trade.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Growth and economy ◦ Virix receive free Spores each turn — your swarm replenishes without spending BISMUTH on every body.◦ Pair endless bodies with patient timing: sacrifice Spores for high-value structures, not chip damage.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Summary Virix weaponize growth: free Spores, production straight from BISMUTH, and relentless pressure through sacrifice captures.
